units.source_text: 众所周知，与夕佳亭毗邻的是拱北接，楼名出自"北辰之居其所众星拱之"。

en.t: As everyone knows, next to Sekkatei stands Gongbei Pavilion, whose name comes from the saying, "When the North Star stays in its place, all the other stars gather around it."

units.source_text: 但是，现在的拱北楼，与当年义满威震天下时不同了，它是百余年前重建的，成了一个圆形的时尚的茶室。

en.t: But the present Gongbei Pavilion is no longer what it was when Yoshimitsu overawed the realm; it was rebuilt more than a hundred years ago and has become a round, stylish tea room.

units.source_text: 在夕佳亭里看不见老师的身影，他大概是在拱北楼里吧。

en.t: There was no sign of the teacher in Sekkatei; he was probably in Gongbei Pavilion.
